column1: # What stands between the campaign and a LIVE transform kernel in the emulator.
# Cycle 1381 predicted that running the flight step with slot 31 live "needs the
# VMX128 register-file bridge that cycle 1301 built". THAT PREDICTION IS WRONG.
# The run was made twice, identically except for `alias on`:
#   without the bridge   601 steps, 18 callees entered, fault
#   with the bridge      601 steps, 18 callees entered, the SAME fault
# Same step count, same instruction, same message. The bridge is not the blocker
# and was never exercised. What stops it is a single missing p-code operation --
# and then three more behind it.
# WHERE IT STOPS. 0x820A9A64, inside sub_820A99F8, which is rotate_820A99F8 in
# retail_transform.cpp. And the integrator 0x82303110 calls it DIRECTLY: the
# rotation is not reached only through slot 32, which is stubbed in that run.
# The integrator's own fifteen vector mnemonics all execute. The four below are
# what a rotation needs and the module does not supply.
# mnemonic
lvlx

column1: # TOTAL 7671 of the 15945 CALLOTHER sites in the image -- 48%.
# ALL FOUR ARE PURE DATA MOVEMENT. None performs arithmetic, so none can be
# wrong in a way that produces a plausible number: an error shows up as bytes in
# the wrong lane, not as a value one ulp out. That is the cheapest kind of
# asserted semantics to control, and it is why this is worth doing rather than
# routing around.
# THE STATUS THEY WOULD CARRY. Anything supplied through
# registerCallOtherCallback is ASSERTED ISA SEMANTICS, not executed retail code,
# and the harness already labels it that way (`asserted_semantics` in every
# snapshot). The vpermwi128 override is the precedent, and the standard it set is
# that each model is generated from a census of its own sites and validated
# against every immediate the image actually uses.
# AND THE CONTROL IS AVAILABLE FOR FREE. rotate_820A9B30, rotate_820A99F8 and
# rotate_82211828 are ALREADY PORTED and contracted under A3.1, and cycle 1381's
# composite already knows the expected position block from the integrator's own
# contracted differential. So the four models can be checked against a result
# that was established without them.
